correctness.rationale: For k algebraically closed of characteristic 7, f=x^5+a*x^2+b is squarefree exactly when b(b^3+a^5) != 0. Genus is 4 by tame Riemann--Hurwitz. Holomorphic Cartier seventh-power matrix has lower-right block B=[[4a^3b,4b^3,6a^2b^2],[0,5ab,4a^3],[1,0,0]], rank 2 on the smooth locus: a-number 2. After normalizing b=1, exact modular polynomial arithmetic computes gcd of all nonzero 2x2 minors of B^(7)B as u^4(u^10-1), with u^5=a^5/b^3; smoothness excludes u^5=-1. Iterates have ranks 2,1,0 at u=0 and 2,1,1 stable at u^5=1; all other smooth u have rank 2 already after two iterations, yielding p-rank 2. Standalone verifier recomputes matrix, gcd, and exceptional iteration with exact modular arithmetic.

value.rationale: The classical cyclic (3,5) genus-four family motivates this coefficient slice. Across its complete smooth parameter open, Jacobians have a constant a-number 2 while p-rank jumps between exactly three strata 2,1,0 with explicit equations; notably the p-rank-one stratum is smooth. This supplies a natural structural classification, more than an arbitrary small computation or isolated textbook normalization.
